notes.title: Patch 1.6.3.
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
An in-game shop has been added. Maps can now be purchased with points earned. Points are added with kills and can then be spent in Profile > Shop.
The shop is constantly being expanded.

[b]Bug Fix[/b]
Minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.2
notes.notes:
[b]Enemies[/b]
Spiders now have hit feedback, ghosts have been removed.
Insects spawn via eggs.
[b]Bug Fix[/b]
Minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1
notes.notes:
[b]Enemies[/b]
Spider navigation and animations have been improved.
[b]Bug Fix[/b]
A bug that prevented weapon switching has been fixed.
Minor bugs have been fixed.
[b]Sound[/b]
The volume control has been adjusted.
New ambient and SFX sounds have been added.
[b]UI[/b]
Maps can now be configured in the Match Settings menu.
Escape map has been added to Random mode.
[b]Maps[/b]
Several graphics options have been changed in the Backrooms level, and bugs have been fixed.
The Dead Planet level has been reduced in size.
The Medieval Town level has been reduced in size.
The new "Hangar" map has been added.
[b]Gameplay[/b]
Point acquisition has been adjusted.
Match start has been delayed.

notes.title: Patch 1.6.0
notes.notes:
[b]Weapons:[/b]
Melee weapons have been enhanced.

The pistol model has been changed, and the sound has been revised.

[b]UI:[/b]
Elements have been visually modified.

Player icons have been added.

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
Map factory containers could be used as islands where you could not be attacked.

[b]Enemies[/b]
Hit feedback has been added.

[b]Performance:[/b]
Some performance improvements have been made.

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
The scoring system has been adjusted. Points can now be earned in small amounts from enemies and only increase slightly upon killing an enemy.

notes.title: Patch 1.5.9
notes.notes:
[u]GAMEPLAY[/u]

[list]
[*] “Game Stop” pause added to single-player.
[*] Fixed weapon swapping bug.
[*] Actors have been reworked in every map.
[*] Sounds have been reworked for various materials.
[*] Loading screen added to single-player.
[/list]

[u]ENEMIES[/u]

[list]
[*] Spiders are now accompanied by flying insects.
[*] A new boss has been implemented.
[/list]
